definitions.gloss: to collect forcibly; to demand payment; to dun
definitions.explanation: To press someone to pay a debt, tax, or other obligation, often in an aggressive or persistent manner.

definitions.gloss: to single out; to make special mention of; to highlight
definitions.explanation: To pick out and give special attention or emphasis to something. Often used in negative constructions meaning there is nothing worth singling out.

definitions.gloss: to promote; to give a position to; to elevate
definitions.explanation: To appoint or promote someone to a position, especially someone of lower status.

examples.japanese: {借金|しゃっきん}を{取|と}り{立|た}てる。
{毎日|まいにち}{取|と}り{立|た}ての{電話|でんわ}がかかってくる。
{業者|ぎょうしゃ}が{厳|きび}しく{取|と}り{立|た}てるので、{生活|せいかつ}が{苦|くる}しくなった。
examples.english: The creditor's harsh debt collection has made life difficult.

examples.japanese: {取|と}り{立|た}てて{言|い}うことはない。
examples.english: There's nothing worth singling out to mention.

examples.japanese: {取|と}り{立|た}てて{問題|もんだい}はなかった。
examples.english: There were no particular problems worth mentioning.

examples.japanese: {取|と}り{立|た}てて{特徴|とくちょう}のない{町|まち}だが、{住|す}みやすい。
examples.english: It's a town with nothing particularly distinctive, but it's easy to live in.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}い{社員|しゃいん}を{部長|ぶちょう}に{取|と}り{立|た}てた。
examples.english: A young employee was promoted to department head.

examples.japanese: {殿様|とのさま}は{身分|みぶん}の{低|ひく}い{者|もの}を{取|と}り{立|た}てて{家臣|かしん}にした。
examples.english: The lord elevated a person of low status and made him a retainer.

examples.japanese: {才能|さいのう}のある{若者|わかもの}を{取|と}り{立|た}てて{重要|じゅうよう}な{役職|やくしょく}に{就|つ}かせた。
examples.english: They promoted talented young people and placed them in important positions.

notes:
Compound verb of {取|と}る (to take) + {立|た}てる (to set up, establish). The three senses are quite distinct in usage.

USAGE:
Sense 1 (debt collection) is common in financial and legal contexts, and in stories about loan sharks. Sense 2 is very frequently used in the adverbial form {取|と}り{立|た}てて, almost always in negative constructions ({取|と}り{立|た}てて～ない = "nothing particularly..."). Sense 3 (promote) has a somewhat historical or literary feel and implies elevating someone from a lower position.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {借金|しゃっきん}を{取|と}り{立|た}てる — to collect a debt
- {取|と}り{立|た}てて～ない — nothing particularly...
- {人材|じんざい}を{取|と}り{立|た}てる — to promote talent
- {厳|きび}しく{取|と}り{立|た}てる — to collect harshly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {徴収|ちょうしゅう}する — to collect, levy (official/institutional, more neutral)
- {催促|さいそく}する — to press, urge (less aggressive than {取|と}り{立|た}てる)
- {抜擢|ばってき}する — to promote, single out for advancement (more formal, positive nuance)
